note: _mortificare_ = to mortify, abtöten (as an act of asceticism). The word has strongly influenced the history of Christian asceticism. Already used by Augustine (_De doctrina christiana_ 1,25; PL 34: 28), it came to dominate spiritual language in Thomas a Kempis’s _De imitatione Christi_.

_sed omnia et in omnibus Christus_. Thus correctly in the 7th edition of the Weber/Gryson Vulgate. Instead of _et_, the earlier editions had _er_ (a printing error not found in other editions of the Vulgate New Testament).
